text:
ashley: Heads up — we just found a critical tokenization edge-case in prod affecting requests > 4096 tokens. Seeing ~0.02% failure rate, customer impact on long-form generation. Need an expedited hotfix deploy in the next window. Can we get ops sign-off?
maria: can you paste the failing stack or repro?
ashley: quick stack snippet: `IndexError: kv_cache index out of range` after step 3 in streaming. Repro with long prompt + tool calls.
sam: estimated fix is tiny (bounds check + defensive trim). I have image ready: `gcr.io/redwood/serving:fix/kv-bounds-2026-03-21`.
liam: rolling this without a canary will be risky. what's the rollback plan?
ashley: rollback is immediate image rollback via deploybot: `deploybot rollback image gcr.io/redwood/serving:canary` and circuit-breaker cutoff if errors > 0.5% for 5m.
deploybot: @channel detected: image available `gcr.io/redwood/serving:fix/kv-bounds-2026-03-21`. Canary pipeline can run now. To proceed run `deploybot promote canary --image=gcr.io/redwood/serving:fix/kv-bounds-2026-03-21 --window=15m`.
maria: ops OK if canary runs for 15m and metrics look good. I can approve after 10m if stable.
ashley: request: expedite pin to EU1 and US1, small canary (5% traffic), then fast rollforward if canary healthy. Need approvals from eng-releases and oncall.
liam: +1 for expedited, but hold if latency spikes >100ms p50.
oncall-bot: @oncall liam you are oncall for eng-releases. Please ack.
liam: acked.
maria: +1 from me.
sam: pushing canary now. kicking off: `deploybot promote canary --image=gcr.io/redwood/serving:fix/kv-bounds-2026-03-21 --pct=5 --regions=eu1,us1`
deploybot: Canary started. tracking: https://deploy.redwood.example/canary/1802509876 (will report status updates here).
ashley: publishing release note draft for docs: "Fix: prevent kv cache index overflow on very long generations (edge cases >4096 tokens). No model change. Rolling binary patch to serving runtime."
liam: saw a small spike in error rate at +3m in eu1 (0.12%). watching.
maria: telemetry looks stable in us1. eu1 small blip but recovering. hold for 10 more minutes and re-evaluate.
ashley: understood — pausing fast rollforward. If eu1 stays <=0.2% for next 7m we proceed.
ashley: ops note for release: rollback command quickref: `deploybot rollback image gcr.io/redwood/serving:canary --regions=eu1` and to cut traffic: `deploybot set-traffic serving --pct=0 --region=eu1`
liam: eu1 error rate back down to 0.01% and p50 latency unchanged.
maria: good to go for fast rollforward. +1 final.
sam: executing rollforward to 100% in eu1/us1: `deploybot promote stable --image=gcr.io/redwood/serving:fix/kv-bounds-2026-03-21 --regions=eu1,us1 --stagger=2m`
deploybot: Rollforward in progress. Staggering by region. Monitoring: errors, latency, token throughput.
ashley: posting short release note to #release-notes after roll completes.
deploybot: Rollforward complete. No elevated errors detected in last 10m. Summary: eu1 errors 0.01% -> 0.01%, us1 0.0% -> 0.0%.
maria: verified. tagging release: `serving@2026.03.21-fix-kv`
liam: thanks all. closing expedited hotfix. reminder to follow up with a postmortem with repro case and test added.
ashley: will add unit+integration test for long prompts and update changelog. thx :thumbsup:
sam: adding release note now: "Patch: kv-cache bounds check to avoid index overflow on very long generations. Deployed 2026-03-21. No model changes."
liam: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
